::: {.callout-tip icon=false}
## How to use this page

1. **Adjust** any of the model parameters using the sliders / inputs below. The headline outcomes (deaths averted, burden avoided, net monetary benefit, ROI) update **live in your browser** — nothing is sent to any server.
2. **Export** your scenario by clicking *Download my scenario CSV*. Save the file with a meaningful name (e.g. `scenario_low_eta.csv`).
3. **Reload later** by clicking *Import a saved scenario* and selecting your saved CSV — the inputs will repopulate from the file.
4. **Reset** at any time using the *Reset to canonical v3* button.

The starting values are loaded from the canonical [`amua_import_parameters_v3.csv`](amua_import_parameters_v3.csv). For provenance and source citations on every parameter, see the [Parameters Hub](parameters_hub.html).
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// ---------- Load canonical CSV ----------
csvText = FileAttachment("amua_import_parameters_v3.csv").text()

canonical = {
  const lines = csvText.split("\n").filter(l => l && !l.startsWith("#") && !l.startsWith("Name,"));
  const out = {};
  for (const line of lines) {
    const m = line.match(/^([^,]+),([^,]+),(.*)$/);
    if (!m) continue;
    const [, name, expr, notes] = m;
    const v = parseFloat(expr);
    if (!isNaN(v)) out[name.trim()] = { value: v, notes };
  }
  return out;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// ---------- Imported-scenario state ----------
mutable importedScenario = null

viewof importFile = Inputs.file({
  label: "Import a saved scenario",
  accept: ".csv",
  multiple: false
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

handleImport = {
  if (importFile) {
    const text = await importFile.text();
    const lines = text.split("\n").filter(l => l && !l.startsWith("#") && !l.startsWith("Name,"));
    const obj = {};
    for (const line of lines) {
      const m = line.match(/^([^,]+),([^,]+),(.*)$/);
      if (!m) continue;
      const v = parseFloat(m[2]);
      if (!isNaN(v)) obj[m[1].trim()] = v;
    }
    mutable importedScenario = obj;
    return html`<div class="alert alert-success" style="padding:8px;background:#cfc;border-left:4px solid #060;margin:8px 0;">
      ✓ Imported ${Object.keys(obj).length} parameters. Adjust below or export again.
    </div>`;
  }
  return html``;
}
```

## Editable parameters

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Helper: starting value picks (a) imported scenario, (b) canonical v3
function start(name) {
  if (importedScenario && importedScenario[name] !== undefined) return importedScenario[name];
  return canonical[name]?.value ?? 0;
}
```

### Burden

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof n_deaths_statssa_macod = Inputs.range([1000, 4000], {
  step: 50,
  value: start("n_deaths_statssa_macod"),
  label: "Annual deaths (StatsSA MACOD) — n_deaths_statssa_macod ← canonical truth"
})
viewof cfr_headline_mid = Inputs.range([0.05, 0.20], {
  step: 0.005,
  value: start("cfr_headline_mid"),
  label: "Headline case-fatality rate — cfr_headline_mid"
})
viewof n_nmc_annual = Inputs.range([400, 1500], {
  step: 10,
  value: start("n_nmc_annual"),
  label: "Annual NMC notifications — n_nmc_annual"
})
viewof n_burden_true_override = Inputs.range([5000, 25000], {
  step: 100,
  value: start("n_burden_true"),
  label: "True annual burden (override; otherwise derived from StatsSA/CFR) — n_burden_true"
})
viewof use_statssa_burden = Inputs.toggle({
  label: "Derive true burden from StatsSA deaths / CFR (recommended)",
  value: true
})
```

## Live outcomes

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// ---------- Derived calculations ----------
// StatsSA MACOD is the canonical truth source for deaths.
// True burden is derived as deaths / CFR unless user overrides.
n_deaths            = n_deaths_statssa_macod
n_burden_true       = use_statssa_burden ? (n_deaths_statssa_macod / cfr_headline_mid) : n_burden_true_override

// Status-quo per-case detection = N_NMC * CFR / N_deaths_StatsSA
d_status_quo_derived = (n_nmc_annual * cfr_headline_mid) / n_deaths_statssa_macod

C_morbidity         = n_burden_true * c_morbidity_headline
C_mortality         = n_deaths * c_mortality_human_capital
C_burden_total      = C_morbidity + C_mortality

// Detection × efficacy (uses derived d_status_quo if user has not moved the slider far from CSV value)
deaths_averted      = n_deaths * (d_full_package - d_status_quo) * eta_response_mid
cases_averted       = n_burden_true * (d_full_package - d_status_quo) * eta_response_mid
burden_avoided      = C_burden_total * (d_full_package - d_status_quo) * eta_response_mid

// NMB and ROI
NMB_narrow          = burden_avoided - c_full_package_narrow_operating
NMB_wholesystem     = burden_avoided - c_full_package_wholesystem_operating
ROI_narrow          = burden_avoided / c_full_package_narrow_operating
ROI_wholesystem     = burden_avoided / c_full_package_wholesystem_operating

// ---------- Stakeholder split of avoided burden ----------
// Apply the canonical share table (NDoH ~R70M, NHLS ~R10M, OOP ~R10M,
// household mortality ~R2.25B of the R2.34B headline burden) proportionally
// to whatever total burden the user has built with the sliders.
share_doh_frac     = 70e6  / 2340e6   // ~3.0%
share_nhls_frac    = 10e6  / 2340e6   // ~0.4%
share_oop_frac     = 10e6  / 2340e6   // ~0.4%
share_hh_mort_frac = 2250e6 / 2340e6  // ~96.2%

avoided_doh        = burden_avoided * share_doh_frac
avoided_nhls       = burden_avoided * share_nhls_frac
avoided_oop        = burden_avoided * share_oop_frac
avoided_hh_mort    = burden_avoided * share_hh_mort_frac
avoided_health_sys = avoided_doh + avoided_nhls
avoided_household  = avoided_oop + avoided_hh_mort

fmtR = (x) => {
  if (Math.abs(x) >= 1e9) return "R" + (x/1e9).toFixed(2) + " bn";
  if (Math.abs(x) >= 1e6) return "R" + (x/1e6).toFixed(2) + " M";
  if (Math.abs(x) >= 1e3) return "R" + (x/1e3).toFixed(0) + "k";
  return "R" + x.toFixed(0);
}
fmtN = (x) => x.toLocaleString("en-ZA", {maximumFractionDigits: 0});

outcomesTable = Inputs.table([
  {Outcome: "Annual deaths (StatsSA MACOD)",              Value: fmtN(n_deaths)},
  {Outcome: "Implied true burden (cases)",                Value: fmtN(n_burden_true)},
  {Outcome: "Derived d_status_quo = N_NMC·CFR/N_deaths",   Value: d_status_quo_derived.toFixed(3)},
  {Outcome: "Total economic burden / year",               Value: fmtR(C_burden_total)},
  {Outcome: "Cases averted / year (Full Package)",        Value: fmtN(cases_averted)},
  {Outcome: "Deaths averted / year (Full Package)",       Value: fmtN(deaths_averted)},
  {Outcome: "Burden avoided / year",                      Value: fmtR(burden_avoided)},
  {Outcome: "NMB — narrow perspective",                   Value: fmtR(NMB_narrow)},
  {Outcome: "NMB — whole-system perspective",             Value: fmtR(NMB_wholesystem)},
  {Outcome: "ROI — narrow (× per R1 spent)",              Value: ROI_narrow.toFixed(1) + "×"},
  {Outcome: "ROI — whole-system (× per R1 spent)",        Value: ROI_wholesystem.toFixed(1) + "×"}
], {
  rows: 10,
  width: {Outcome: 360, Value: 200}
})
```

### Who bears the cost / who gains?

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

stakeholderTable = Inputs.table([
  {Stakeholder: "NDoH — public hospitals",                    "Annual burden borne": fmtR(C_burden_total * share_doh_frac),     "Burden avoided / yr": fmtR(avoided_doh),       Share: "~3.0%"},
  {Stakeholder: "NHLS — laboratory",                          "Annual burden borne": fmtR(C_burden_total * share_nhls_frac),    "Burden avoided / yr": fmtR(avoided_nhls),      Share: "~0.4%"},
  {Stakeholder: "DALRRD — regulator",                         "Annual burden borne": "R0",                                       "Burden avoided / yr": "R0",                     Share: "0% (lever-holder)"},
  {Stakeholder: "Individuals — OOP + lost wages",             "Annual burden borne": fmtR(C_burden_total * share_oop_frac),     "Burden avoided / yr": fmtR(avoided_oop),       Share: "~0.4%"},
  {Stakeholder: "Households / society — lost lifetime earnings","Annual burden borne": fmtR(C_burden_total * share_hh_mort_frac), "Burden avoided / yr": fmtR(avoided_hh_mort),   Share: "~96.2%"},
  {Stakeholder: "── Health sector subtotal (NDoH + NHLS)",     "Annual burden borne": fmtR(C_burden_total * (share_doh_frac + share_nhls_frac)),  "Burden avoided / yr": fmtR(avoided_health_sys), Share: "~3.4%"},
  {Stakeholder: "── Households + society subtotal",            "Annual burden borne": fmtR(C_burden_total * (share_oop_frac + share_hh_mort_frac)), "Burden avoided / yr": fmtR(avoided_household),  Share: "~96.6%"},
  {Stakeholder: "TOTAL",                                       "Annual burden borne": fmtR(C_burden_total),                       "Burden avoided / yr": fmtR(burden_avoided),    Share: "100%"}
], {
  rows: 9,
  width: {Stakeholder: 360, "Annual burden borne": 160, "Burden avoided / yr": 160, Share: 130}
})
```

*Shares are applied proportionally from the canonical v3 stakeholder table (NDoH ~R70M, NHLS ~R10M, individuals OOP ~R10M, households mortality ~R2.25B of the R2.34B headline). Change any slider above to see how the same shares apply to a different total.*

### What changed from canonical v3?

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

editedKeys = [
  ["n_burden_true", n_burden_true],
  ["cfr_headline_mid", cfr_headline_mid],
  ["c_morbidity_headline", c_morbidity_headline],
  ["c_mortality_human_capital", c_mortality_human_capital],
  ["d_status_quo", d_status_quo],
  ["d_full_package", d_full_package],
  ["eta_response_mid", eta_response_mid],
  ["c_full_package_narrow_operating", c_full_package_narrow_operating],
  ["c_full_package_wholesystem_operating", c_full_package_wholesystem_operating]
]

deltaTable = Inputs.table(
  editedKeys.map(([k, v]) => {
    const base = canonical[k]?.value;
    const delta = base ? ((v - base) / base * 100) : 0;
    return {
      Parameter: k,
      "Canonical (v3)": base,
      "Your value": v,
      "Δ %": (delta >= 0 ? "+" : "") + delta.toFixed(1) + "%"
    };
  }),
  {width: {Parameter: 320, "Canonical (v3)": 130, "Your value": 130, "Δ %": 80}}
)
```
:::

## Export / reset

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Build a CSV that mirrors the canonical structure for the edited parameters
exportCSV = {
  const header = "Name,Expression,Notes\n";
  const note = (k) => canonical[k]?.notes ?? "User-edited via Parameter Playground";
  const rows = editedKeys.map(([k, v]) => `${k},${v},${note(k)}`).join("\n");
  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().split(".")[0];
  return header
    + `# Scenario exported from Parameter Playground at ${timestamp},,\n`
    + `# Canonical baseline: amua_import_parameters_v3.csv,,\n`
    + rows + "\n";
}

downloadLink = {
  const blob = new Blob([exportCSV], {type: "text/csv"});
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  return html`<a href="${url}" download="d2p_scenario_${new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]}.csv"
                 style="display:inline-block;padding:10px 18px;background:#04a;color:white;
                        text-decoration:none;border-radius:4px;font-weight:bold;margin:8px 4px;">
    ⬇ Download my scenario CSV
  </a>`;
}

resetButton = html`<button onclick="window.location.reload()"
  style="display:inline-block;padding:10px 18px;background:#666;color:white;
         border:none;border-radius:4px;font-weight:bold;cursor:pointer;margin:8px 4px;">
  ↺ Reset to canonical v3
</button>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div>${downloadLink}${resetButton}</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Show CSV preview
htl.html`<details style="margin-top:16px;">
  <summary style="cursor:pointer;font-weight:bold;">Preview the CSV you would export</summary>
  <pre style="background:#f6f6f6;padding:12px;border-radius:4px;font-size:0.85em;overflow-x:auto;">${exportCSV}</pre>
</details>`
```

---

::: {.callout-note icon=false}
## How does this differ from the [Parameters Hub](parameters_hub.html)?

- **Parameters Hub** is the **read-only canonical record** of every parameter with sources. It always reflects the committed `amua_import_parameters_v3.csv`.
- **Parameter Playground** (this page) is a **what-if sandbox**. Edits live only in your browser session, never touch the canonical file, and can be exported / re-imported as CSVs for sharing with colleagues.

To make a scenario *canonical*, share the exported CSV with the project maintainer for review and incorporation into `amua_import_parameters_v3.csv` via a tracked commit.
:::
